findings.evidence: run_owned stores nativeExit/rawWrapperReturnCode, then calls unguarded lib[write] before returning. Fake callbacks reproduce an escaping persistence OSError after native0/7/124/-9. Caller never appends or propagates the result, so the outer phase can retain nativeExit=None and FINALIZE returns observer failure instead of the known nonzero outcome.
